name: runner-offline
description: Acceptance 6: the model runner is offline; the run shim retries on a 2, 4, 8, 10, 10 s backoff and nothing is committed until it returns.

steps.caption: The model runner goes offline (red halo).
A run is requested. The run shim turns amber: retry state belongs to the orchestrator.
The runner is back. The next retry commits F2 and the pipeline continues.
